source_file: Home Equity Loans Classification Tree/HMEQ Classification Tree.sas
notes: PROC HPSPLIT decision-tree fit on HMEQ with two of the script's five split criteria (entropy, gini) plus cost-complexity pruning -- kept distinct from t002's stepwise logistic regression to preserve technique diversity. Original used proc import from a hardcoded local CSV path and wrote code/rules files to the author's local disk; substituted with a 50-row sample (25/25 BAD split, seed=7) drawn from the repo's own shipped hmeq.csv, and dropped the partition/code/rules output clauses that target local paths. CONTENTS/MEANS/FREQ preamble kept as authored.
